about.title: About Us
about.heading: Amira Gold Investment Limited – Precious Metals Excellence Since 1998
about.p1: Amira Gold Investment Limited is your trusted partner for investment and collectible coins, as well as bullion bars and customized minting solutions. As a family-owned company with German roots, we have combined decades of experience, in-depth expertise and an international network since 1998 – now operating from the heart of Dubai.
about.p2: Under the leadership of our experienced management team, Amira Gold Investment Limited continues a successful business model and extensive industry knowledge, bringing German precision and quality with global reach to the United Arab Emirates.
about.p3: As an official distributor of leading mints, we offer our clients not only LBMA-certified investment-grade bullion bars, but also exclusive, limited-edition collectible coins and the latest releases of investment coins, including Maple Leaf, Britannia, Kangaroo, Vienna Philharmonic and Krugerrand.
about.p4: At Amira Gold Investment Limited, you will find a competent, reliable and personal partner who supports you with passion and expertise. Personal consultation, tailor-made solutions, and the highest level of discretion are always our top priorities.

storage.title: Secure storage solutions for your precious metals
storage.subtitle: for your precious metals
storage.p1: In addition to the purchase of investment-grade gold and silver, we offer our clients flexible and highly secure storage solutions – tailored to the individual needs of every investor.
storage.p2: Physical precious metals are a tangible, crisis-proof asset – but they require infrastructure that matches their value. Through our partnerships, we offer secure and flexible storage solutions tailored to our clients' needs.

vintageVaults.title: Vintage Vaults
vintageVaults.description: An exclusive vault facility offering individually allocated safe deposit boxes with full personal access – designed for investors who want hands-on control over their assets, backed by institutional-grade security.
features: Steel-reinforced vaults, 24/7 monitoring, direct Dubai Police linkage
Insurance coverage up to AED 2 million
Dual-key system — only you hold access to your box
Strict NDAs for all staff, full privacy guaranteed
Box sizes XXS to XXL, rental periods ranging from 3 months to 10 years
Daily access 10:00 AM to midnight, including weekends

loomis.title: Loomis Storage
loomis.description: Our official long-term storage partner. A high-security, customs-bonded warehouse built for larger holdings. Assets are secured immediately after purchase and protected by 24/7 professional guard services.
features: Designed for long-term storage of larger holdings
Personal access and regular visits are generally not intended
Withdrawal available at any time upon request
